Alex (Security): Heads-up: GA’ing a small but important change to Private/VPC telemetry policy tonight 23:00 UTC. Reason: during last week's customer incident we found ambiguous telemetry semantics that confused post-incident audits. This clarifies what "local-only" telemetry means and adds an incident-export flag for customers to produce immutable incident bundles.

Marta (Product): TL;DR: (1) "local-only" telemetry will never be sent off-host unless customer enables incident-export; (2) incident-export produces a signed, time-stamped bundle customers can store; (3) updated contract wording + KB.

Devon (Eng): Implementation note: agent config adds `incident_export.enabled=false` by default. Enabling requires `agent.admin` permission and a signed consent token. Example enable: ```curl -X POST https://127.0.0.1:8443/agent/config -H 'Authorization: Bearer <admin_token>' -d '{"incident_export":{"enabled":true}}'``` Trigger export: ```POST /agent/incident/export -d '{"incident_id":"2026-05-03-ACME-1"}'``` returns `bundle_id` + `signed_manifest`.

incident-bot: incident-bot: Detected anomaly: last week's private-vpc-ACME incident generated 1 ambiguous telemetry assertion at 2026-05-03T02:14Z.

Riley (SRE): Rollout plan: canary 12 agents 23:00-23:20 UTC. Monitoring: `incident-bundle-gen-fail`, `local-telemetry-leak` (should be zero). If bundle-gen-fail > 0.2% over 5m or any local-telemetry-leak alert, rollback. I'll post live metrics.

Priya (Legal): Quick legal note: we need the signed_manifest to include signer_kid, canonicalized event list, SHA256 manifest, and a human-readable line for audit reports. Draft line: "Customer incident bundles include a signed manifest (bundle_id, signer_kid, manifest_sha256, timestamp) to allow independent verification of exported telemetry."

Jon (Sales): Can we get a 1-sentence customer blurb for CSMs? Also a list of canary customers so CSMs can pre-notify.

Kim (Support): I'll add KB: "How to enable incident-export and verify bundles" with these steps: enable flag, generate export, validate signer_kid, verify manifest SHA256, collect local logs if mismatch. Also add canned responses for CSMs.

Devon (Eng): Canary started at 2026-05-15T23:00Z. 12 agents, 0 bundle failures so far, median bundle gen 95ms.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout initiated for private-telemetry-policy-clarify-v1 at 2026-05-15T23:00Z.

Riley (SRE): Canary update @23:12: still green. No `local-telemetry-leak` alerts. Promoting to full rollout in 10m if stable.

Alex (Security): Post-rollout ask: add an incident checklist item for verifying `incident_export.enabled` status and collecting signed bundles within the first 30 minutes of any customer incident.

Priya (Legal): Legal sign-off conditional on KB link + the final audit sentence included in customer communications.

Jon (Sales): Draft blurb for CSMs: "We've tightened Private/VPC telemetry semantics. Exporting telemetry for incident review now requires explicit customer enablement and produces a signed bundle for audits."

Kim (Support): I'll link KB here once live: https://redir.company/kb/onprem-incident-export (placeholder). Adding escalation steps to #eng-oncall.

Riley (SRE): Full rollout kicked at 2026-05-15T23:32Z. Metrics: bundle-gen-fail 0.03%, median gen 100ms, no telemetry leaks detected.

Alex (Security): Thanks. Follow-ups: (1) update contracts team with new wording; (2) add incident-export tests to CI; (3) schedule a 30m cross-team retro Friday to review last week's incident and lessons learned.

Marta (Product): I'll coordinate retro and draft GA announcement for tomorrow 10:00 UTC after Legal and Support confirm KB links. If anything odd in next 48h ping #eng-oncall and tag @Marta. :megaphone:
